GoldArmor strategy: how the XAUUSD gold EA trades breakouts

GoldArmor EA monitors XAUUSD price structure across timeframes. After a breakout, momentum informs entry and volatility and open positions guide the exit.

GoldArmor AIGroup business brand
01

Trading logic

A gold price move can look different across timeframes. GoldArmor checks breakout conditions at several levels, then evaluates direction and momentum. When its rules are met, the EA handles orders, open positions and exits. The available analysis features depend on the version.

02

Risks & boundaries

Volatility and existing positions affect the exit rules. Price gaps, thin liquidity or a cluster of fills can move the exit away from its intended price. Match the account, strategy version and reporting period when reviewing drawdown.

03

Operating requirements

The product site describes an ECN account trading XAUUSD. Spreads, commissions and order latency affect the cost of frequent execution. The figures below come from project materials cited by GoldArmor for September 6, 2026.
